observations.title: Harvest and replant a ripe crop
observations.player_action: Right-click a supported harvestable plant with any tool required by server configuration.
observations.outcome: The crop is harvested and seeds replanted by the native interaction.
conditions: Server support is required; Require Hoe can make empty-hand interaction do nothing.
External documentation is not installed-runtime proof; inspect the installed artifact/configuration before relying on defaults or exact compatibility.
observations.review_note: A crop item in inventory cannot prove right-click harvesting or replanting. Use the native harvest interaction/event plus actual crop state for such quests.

observations.title: Use an appropriate hoe for a larger harvest
observations.player_action: Inspect hoe tier, Fortune and the server's radius/hunger/experience settings before harvesting.
observations.outcome: Configured tool tier can expand the harvest area, and Fortune can affect yield.
conditions: The page's broad modded-crop support claim is not exact proof for every installed crop.
External documentation is not installed-runtime proof; inspect the installed artifact/configuration before relying on defaults or exact compatibility.
